notes: Expected shared-prior misreads, in likelihood order: (1) VAMP GATING — the skill1 stack block is the trap line: 'only activates when attacking in Vamp status' must be armed by the first fullBurstEnter and then stay open FOREVER (no boss damage in v1 ⇒ the removal clause never fires). Both an ungated model (stacks from t=0) and an FB-window-scoped model (stacks only inside Full Bursts) are plausible and wrong in opposite directions; the between-FB buffApply assertion kills both. (2) FLAVOR COUPLING — sustainedDamagePct is only worth anything because the burst DoT is sustained-flavored; encoding the stat as attackDamagePct OR the DoT as unflavored each silently breaks the pair while every test that only checks totals-moved stays green. Assert the pair jointly (tick mult grows with stacks; nuke and normals do not). (3) DEF ▼ — the types.ts comment 'defPct: inert in v1' is about SELF DEF (Endurance cube); the boss's DEF is a live formula term, so a reviewer-driver shared prior of 'DEF lines are defensive, skip' would drop real team-wide damage. If the engine genuinely lacks an enemy-DEF branch, the line must surface as a declared GAP with an estimated team-wide magnitude, never a silent skip — the team-wide A/B assertion makes silence red. (4) REENTER STAGE 2 is invisible in any single-B2 comp; controlComp(viper) happens to include crown (Burst II), which is exactly the fixture that exposes an omission — assert crown's per-rotation burstCast count, and judge by FB-count preservation. (5) 'Stage target appears' refire on boss transitions is a genuine ⚑ ambiguity — one t≈0 application is the conservative faithful read; a refire model is MEASUREMENT-GATED, not assumable. (6) All hit-rate magnitudes are kit-stated (DATAMINED) but their damage effect routes through the engine-global hit-rate→core conversion, which is CALIBRATED ⚑ and measured-only per the always-⚑ list — tests should assert the buffApply values and stack/duration shape, not a derived core-rate delta. (7) Fixture sanity: viper is Burst II — she is the 'carry' but NOT a B3; controlComp's liter B1/crown B2/helm B3 frame is what makes her bursts and Full Bursts actually cast, and her own casts compete with crown for the stage-2 slot until the re-enter line is modeled.
